name: Cleaving Iron
description: Cut through a foe's weapon, shield and body in one stroke with a bar of grown iron the length of a spear.

name: Ferrous Surge
description: Send a surge of iron rising from the ground in a wide wave that bowls over all foes before the user.

name: Gleaming Chains
description: Loose chains of bright iron from the user's hands and bind a strong foe hand and foot.

name: Unyielding Ironmantle
description: Wear a mantle of iron that does not bend and does not break against any blow short of the same grade.

name: Iron Reign
description: Lay the weight of the user's metal qi on the metal of every foe nearby so their weapons and armor sag and drag at their wearers.

name: Steel Shroud
description: Wrap the user in a shroud of tuned steel that cancels the force of one incoming technique of metal.

name: Ruin Edge
description: Cut with an edge that finds the one flaw in a foe's defense and passes through it whatever the armor.

name: Ferrous Phase
description: Let the body pass through iron and steel as if they were water, to cross a barred door or a line of shields.

name: Law Anvil
description: A school move of the law: one blow struck in the name of the law, whose weight scales to the user's own grade.

name: Iron Canon
description: A school move of the law: a recited guard of iron around the user, whose strength scales to the user's own grade.

name: Unbroken Ring
description: A school move of the law: a ring of iron closed round a foe and named whole, scaling to the user's own grade.

name: Last Iron
description: Draw all the iron within a great region into one falling mass that crushes the ground flat, a ruin of the largest scale a Core cultivator can bring to bear and one that leaves the user's reserve spent.

name: Law of Iron
description: Name one piece of iron, bronze or steel aloud and declare it whole: for as long as the user holds the name, nothing at all breaks it, cuts it or bends it, however great the force; no cultivation mechanic explains why a spoken name holds a thing together. A successful use is a Part 27 consequence event.

name: Prime Edge
description: Cut with the first edge, the one from which the user's other edges descend, through guard and armor together.

name: Origin Plate
description: Raise a plate of the oldest metal, which stops the first and heaviest blow of a strong foe.

name: Genesis Shard
description: Loose a shard of new-made metal at a distant foe at speeds that allow no parry.

name: Linking Law
description: Link a foe's weapon, armor and limbs to one another with lines of metal qi so that none can move without dragging the others.

name: Genesis Hammer
description: Strike with a hammer made of fresh metal on the instant of the blow, whose weight is that of the whole world's iron.

name: Ferrous Sphere
description: Close a sphere of metal about the user and turn it so that every blow is carried round and away.

name: Ending Edge
description: Cut once at the end of a foe's guard so that no armor or technique can lessen the wound.

name: Alloy Passage
description: Dissolve into a stream of alloy that passes through a barred gate and re-forms on the other side.

name: Origin Blade
description: A school move of the last weapon: a single cut in the manner of the first blade, scaling to the user's own grade.

name: Genesis Anvil
description: A school move of the last weapon: an anvil struck into being beneath the foes, scaling to the user's own grade.

name: Last Shield
description: A school move of the last weapon: a single shield made as if it were the last, scaling to the user's own grade.

name: Sky Splitter
description: Draw a line of divine metal across the sky and bring it down as a blade that splits a region in two, the largest ruin a divine cultivator can bring to bear, leaving the user spent.

name: Last Weapon
description: Gather every weapon the user has ever made into one and strike with it a single time, with the ruin of the largest scale a divine cultivator can bring to bear.

name: Metal Genesis
description: Draw from nothing a mass of metal of any shape and size the user can hold in mind, as if it had always lain in that place: no cultivation mechanic explains matter that comes without a source. A successful use is a Part 27 consequence event.

name: World Edge
description: Draw an edge through the bond between a target and what is bound to it, an oath, a name, a debt or a tie of blood, and cut it as through a steel thread: no cultivation mechanic explains how a bond can be cut. A successful use is a Part 27 consequence event.
